entries.e8074c208ac81b87: As “Tomoe of Technology,” the company aims to contribute to society and earn customers' trust and satisfaction by creating technically distinctive products and construction methods and providing them with quality first and at low cost. Its basic strategy is to uphold its identity as a technology-based company while improving and strengthening its corporate structure, expanding business domains and creating new businesses, and mobilizing the full strength of the group, in order to raise corporate value. In addition, it is pursuing the 3rd medium-term management plan as one group, adding securing business continuity and taking on the challenge of transformation.
